context:
Goal: plain words for 'box' and 'run' on every screen.
Problem (goal): these are the words you will read every day; only you can pick them.
Based on (read): the sweep found no earlier pick of replacement words.
The sweep found no earlier pick of replacement words. The glossary draft and term-audit spec lean the other way ('Box everywhere', 'Run price table'), so whatever you pick here overrides them. Options are as before.
home: a new decision record for the retired words

options.gain: Both words are already in the records, so less to teach.
options.how: Box becomes drawer. A run becomes the selection it covers, or the send when it lists.
options.label: Drawer, and selection or send
options.lose: 'Drawer' may not fit how you think of your storage.

options.how: Box becomes location. A run becomes a batch.
options.label: Location, and batch
options.lose: New words to teach, and 'batch' also means the merge batches.

ref: Item 94; D56 and D153 (drawer); D180 (selection); D273 (send)
title: Which words replace 'box' and 'run'?
why: Both are already settled terms in the records.
